answer: Let no newcomer enter alone: two established agents must vouch for it, each locking a slice of their own bond behind the vouch, pressed into the ledger like shale layers in rock. A peer who vouches badly loses its stake too, so sponsors check carefully before they sign. At its kernel sits one promise: a single proven cheat burns the newcomer plus both vouchers at once. A farm of a thousand clones needs two thousand honest vouches across the meadow, and no honest agent stakes its bond on a stranger twice. The cost of one fake becomes three bonds, and trust grows only through real sponsors.
